# We have the venmo access token and roommate emails. Let's create the payment requests and the payment.
# Compute shares: taxi = 73/4 = 18.25, dinner = 122/4 = 30.5
taxi_share = 73 / 4
dinner_share = 122 / 4

# Roommate emails from phone contacts
roommate_emails = {
    "Jordan": "jo-harr@gmail.com",
    "Nancy": "nan_ritt@gmail.com",
    "Troy": "tr_solo@gmail.com"
}

# Create payment requests for taxi fare from each roommate
for name, email in roommate_emails.items():
    result = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(
        user_email=email,
        amount=taxi_share,
        access_token=venmo_token,
        description="Taxi Fare"
    )
    print(f"Taxi request to {name}: {result}")

# Create payment to Nancy for dinner bill
result = apis.venmo.create_transaction(
    receiver_email=roommate_emails["Nancy"],
    amount=dinner_share,
    access_token=venmo_token,
    description="Dinner Bill"
)
print(f"Dinner payment to Nancy: {result}")
